headline_seed: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering - BBC
draft_text:
A US jury in Brooklyn convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 counts — trade-secret theft and bank fraud among them — but acquitted on the top RICO charge.
BBC News and the Financial Times both confirm the 10-of-12 tally.

And that's the mews.
